answer: Each agent registers a TPM/SGX enclave key; a zero-knowledge attestation circuit binds its measured model, hardware nonce, and hardware clock-drift bound into the nectar state tree, while wander is a VDF hash anchor and saffron is the consensus contract. Forging an identity requires controlling a distinct physical enclave and recomputing the VDF sequentially; identities pay an O(N^2) bonding curve, with equivocation causing irreversible collateral slashing.
